name: Eterspire
description:
About This Game

Eterspire is a cozy old-school MMORPG built for players who love real progression, charming fantasy worlds, and the satisfying grind of classic MMOs.

Explore the handcrafted world of Aetera, level up through quests and combat, collect gear, customize your adventurer, and team up with other players in real-time co-op challenges. Whether you play on PC or mobile, Eterspire offers a friendly, free-to-play MMO experience with cross-platform play, frequent updates, and a community-focused world that keeps growing.

If you miss the feeling of classic MMORPGs, where you earn your strength, discover new places, and become part of a living online world, Eterspire is made for you.

A COZY OLD-SCHOOL MMORPG

Eterspire blends the charm of classic fantasy MMOs with a welcoming, modern experience. Explore peaceful towns, deep forests, ancient ruins, and dangerous dungeons as you carve your path through Aetera.

Meet quirky characters, discover new regions, and adventure through a world full of little secrets and easter eggs!

REAL PROGRESSION THAT FEELS REWARDING

Level up by battling monsters, completing quests, collecting loot, and upgrading your gear. Your character grows through play, effort, and dedication.

There are no paid top-tier weapons or instant power shortcuts. Your strength comes from your journey through the world!

PLAY ON PC AND MOBILE WITH CROSSPLAY

Your adventure follows you wherever you go. Play Eterspire on Steam or mobile and continue your progress across platforms.

Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse, touchscreen, or controller, Eterspire is designed to be easy to pick up and comfortable to play.

TEAM UP FOR CO-OP PvE TRIALS

Join parties of up to 4 players and take on Trials, wave-based PvE challenges with rare gear drops.

Coordinate with your party, survive enemy waves, and push your build further as you face Aetera’s toughest combat challenges!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ADVENTURER

Choose your class, collect armor and weapons, and create a look that feels truly yours.

With Eterspire’s cosmetic crafting system, you can turn gear into cosmetics, letting you wear your favorite equipment styles without sacrificing your stats.

CONTROLLER SUPPORT

Eterspire supports a wide variety of wired and Bluetooth controllers, with intuitive mappings for both combat and UI.

JOIN A FRIENDLY MMORPG COMMUNITY

Eterspire is more than just a game; it’s a growing community of adventurers.

Chat, trade, party up, join contests, take part in events, and connect with the developers through community Q&As and Discord. Eterspire is built alongside its players, with regular feedback, improvements, and new content.

NEW CONTENT EVERY 2 WEEKS

Aetera keeps growing with biweekly updates, feature improvements, events, fresh content, and new goals to chase.

There is always something new to discover, collect, or master.
short_desc: Eterspire is a cozy old-school MMORPG where skill and dedication define your progression. Grind for gear, explore the vibrant world of Aetera, discover new content every two weeks, and join a growing, welcoming community in a free-to-play MMO with PC and mobile crossplay.
